name: @underload/nexus
description: Nexus Monitor — read-only observability console for a nexus hub: a static Vite + React dashboard that polls the hub's GET /v1/observe snapshot and GET /metrics Prometheus endpoint straight from the browser.
#server: The hub itself (the Rust axum + tokio server that SERVES /v1/observe and /metrics) is no longer in this package — it moved to `@services/nexus` (noobscript `services/nexus`). This package, and the underloadjs/nexus repo it mirrors, ship only the monitoring UI that reads those APIs.
#install: Standalone project with its own committed yarn.lock, like the other standalone mirrors (packages/underload/bench, packages/underload/dashboard): the GitHub Pages workflow checks out this repo and installs here. Inside the noobscript monorepo this same manifest is a workspace member (`packages/underload/*` in the root workspaces), where a root install hoists these deps — see README 'Run it locally'.
author: NQQT
